subject: general
question: Which of the given pairs is NOT matched correctly?

options.text: Bari Doab - between Beas and Ravi
Bisht Doab - between Beas and Chenab
Rachna Doab - between Ravi and Chenab
Jech Doab - between Chenab and Jhelum

solution:
The correct answer is __**Bisht Doab - between Beas and Chenab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The term **Doab** refers to the land lying between two rivers, derived from the Persian words "do" (two) and "ab" (water).
 
• The **Bisht Doab** is incorrectly stated as being between the Beas and Chenab rivers. This pairing does not geographically exist.
